prefix_rule: Source block_number strictly below 14602790. Same-block earlier transactions are excluded. Report all-window preceding notifications and same-UTC-day cap consumption separately.
first_notification_rule: First notification_emitted=true decision whose source transaction belongs to the frozen positive set; retain source coordinates and logical notification_time_ns.
claim_scope: One L2-exposed incident; nine deterministic descriptive cells, not nine tests or an independent recall estimate. Unlabelled/proposal transactions remain unknown, not negatives. Logical notification admission is not observed delivery, intervention or prevention.
